headline: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank raises $500m in perpetual sukuk for growth strategy
summary: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank raised $500 million through dollar-denominated AT1 Islamic bonds, which will be listed and traded on the London Stock Exchange.
why: Perpetual sukuk issuances bolster Tier 1 capital ratios for Islamic financial institutions while diversifying their funding base across international exchanges.

impacts.name: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank
impacts.why: Capital-raising transactions expand the bank's financial resources to support lending and balance sheet expansion.
